subject: general
question: Which architect designed the Gateway of India located at Mumbai?
solution:
The correct answer is __**George Wittet.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ​The Gateway of India is an arch monument built during the** 20th century in Bombay**, India.
 
• The monument was erected to commemorate the landing of King George V and Queen Mary.
 
• The final design of **George Wittet** was sanctioned in** 1914.**
 
• The construction of the monument was completed in **1924.**
 
• The Gateway of India is located on the waterfront at the **Apollo Bunder area** at the end of Chhatrapati Shivaji Marg in South Mumbai.
 
• It overlooks the** Arabian Sea.**
 
• The monument has also been referred to as the **Taj Mahal of Mumbai.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The architectural design of the Gateway of India was fashioned by architect, George Wittet.
 
• It took** 4 years **to complete this monument's construction.
 
• This plan was approved only in **1914**, the reclamations at Apollo Bunder were completed only in **1919.**
 
• The main objective behind its construction was to commemorate the visit of **King George V and Queen Mary **to Mumbai.
 
• **In March 1911, Sir George Sydenham Clark**e, who was then the Governor of Bombay, laid down the monument's first foundation.
